notes.title: Update 1.1.3 - 01/04/2025
notes.notes:
- BUG Fix - Fixed a issue where a power up timer wouldnt appear in splitscreen sometimes.
 - BUG Fix - Smoke screen in split screen mode now appears again.
 - BUG Fix - Shields and asteroid blasters have been resized to encompass the entire ship.
 - BUG Fix - Orange Sacucer is now oriented the correct way.
 - BUg Fix - Getting over 50k in hard mode no longer freezes the game over panel.

notes.title: Minor patch update
notes.notes:
Update 1.1.2
 - BUG Fix - Fixed a issue that caused no ships to spawn in story mode.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Update 1.1 is here bringing lots of new things for you all.
Update 1.1.0
 - Added - Active power up timers that show on the right hand side.
 - Added - Tutorial that teaches the basics.
 - Added - Hard mode, throttle is always at max and no brakes.
 - Added - Daily Leaderoard event, this is a 1 shot seeded race.
 - Added - Weekly Leaderboard event, this is a seeded race.
 - Added - The game now supports remote play together for split screen mode.
 - Added - A short replay when you miss a checkpoint in any endless race.
 - Added - New ship skins that can be unlocked in endless mode.
 - Added - Career stats(Races, distance travelled, ship unlocked etc...)
 - Added - 13 new steam achievements
 - Changed - Ship Repair power up buffed now repairs 20/40/60
 - Changed - Gauges UI is now animated.
 - Changed - Main menu now contains a sub menu for race types.
 - BUG Fix - Stopped the timer showing in endless race if a split screen race had been quit early.
 - BUG Fix - Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the 2nd split screen race to have a negative timer.

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
- Added a new power up "Armour Plating" it will add 5/10/15 to your max hull for the rest of the run.
 - Added the chance of a 3rd checkpoint spawning.
   - They will have double the score value of the original checkpoint.
   - They will be much further away causing the player to risk slowing down.

 - Bug Fix - Power up memory allocation now claered when power up despawns.

 - Changed the UI to show the max hull when in Gameplay mode.
 - Changed the spawn chance of power ups from 30% to 60%.
 - Changed asteroid starting size to be bigger.
 - Changed the asteroid size change to happen slower to account for starting larger.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
- Added descriptions to the main menu screen.
 - Added all ships to now show in endless mode, but you cannot fly locked ships.
 - Added all ships to now show in split screen mode, but you cannot fly locked ships.
 - Added a crosshair that can be toggled on/off using "T"/X(xbox)/Square(Playstation).
 - Bug Fix - Fixed an issue where the wrong score achievements were showing achieved in game.
 - Bug Fix - Fixed leaderboards scene, so that you can show leaderboards before release date.
 - Changed the story mode race results to stay on screen on you choose when to move on.
 - Changed the nitro duration boosters in story mode to say it will increase the charge time.
 - Changed the nitro duration boosters value so they dont increase so drastically.
 - Changed the threshold for nitro charge to start from 95% top speed to 90% top speed.
 - Changed settings/controls to include toggle crosshair.
 - Changed settings/controls descriptions for controllers.

notes.title: 1.0.2 - Update
notes.notes:
- Added a changelog ingame.
 - Added a pause menu to every game mode, open using start on controller or ESC on keyboard.
 - Added increased time factor in story mode if you run out of fuel or have 0 hull.
 - Added a restart season menu, to restart current season, or restart from the beginning of story mode.
 - Fixed a grammer error in season 4 race 5 dialogue.
 - Fixed repeating audio in season 3 race 8.
 - Fixed issue with toggling speedo type in story mode.
 - Fixed skip dialogue button in story mode, not showing if you have already seen the dialogue before.
 - Fixed an issue that showed an empty new ship slot when completing story mode.
 - Fixed an issue that tried to start season 6 when completing story mode, it will now just take you to the main menu.
 - Fixed an issue that allowed you to take damage from asteroids before the race started.
 - Fixed an issue that wouldnt select a new ship for new season using the enter key.
 - Fixed an issue that stop you clicking race/main menu with the mouse in the story league table scene.
 - Fixed the skip announcer button not showing keyboard keybind.
 - Fixed the issue of restarting season 5 after completing story mode, it will now return to season 1.
 - Changed the shield power up to stop you taking damage from asteroids while active.
 - Chagned the developer score on the monthly leaderboard to include DEV - and be green to highlight the developer.
 - Changed the game to save when Robo Chuckles starts to introduce the next race in story mode.
